name: Should I hire a standard painter or a full finish contractor for storm repairs?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a standard painter or a full finish contractor for storm repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dedicated painter generally handles surface preparation, spot caulking, and paint application, but storm damage rarely stops at the surface. Storms often damage framing, soak insulation, ruin drywall, and warp baseboards or casing. A finish contractor can inspect the wall cavity, replace rotted framing or damaged sheetrock, match custom textures, install new trim, and complete the painting. Choosing a contractor skilled in both drywall repair and finish carpentry eliminates the need to coordinate separate handymen, drywalers, and painters to restore your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A finish contractor is better equipped if the storm damaged drywall, insulation, or trim, while a painter typically handles only surface preparation and paint.
